components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Coral action inside labs and dialogs: Show me, Next, Print.
components.css: .ds-btn-main { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font: 700 1rem/1.5 var(--font-sans, ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", "Nunito", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); background: var(--color-coral, #ff7a59); color: var(--color-abyss, #04182b); border: 0; } .ds-btn-main:hover { background: var(--color-coral-light, #ff9577); } .ds-btn-main:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-glow, #5ef2e6); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-main:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: default; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action: Back, Read to me, Walk in 3D.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font: 700 1rem/1.5 var(--font-sans, ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", "Nunito", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); background: transparent; color: var(--color-sand, #fff4e0); border: 2px solid var(--color-line, #1d5580); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--color-glow, #5ef2e6); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-glow, #5ef2e6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Hatch Buttons
components.description: The start screen's two physical hatches; the coral one is Dive in, or Map mode on touch and no-WebGL devices.
components.css: .ds-hatch-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 1rem; background: var(--color-deep, #0a2a45); } .ds-hatch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 1rem 1.75rem; font: 700 1.5rem/1.33 var(--font-sans, ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", "Nunito", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif); white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 22px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.7), inset 0 2px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.25); } .ds-hatch-main { background: var(--color-coral, #ff7a59); color: var(--color-abyss, #04182b); border: 0; border-bottom: 5px solid rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3); } .ds-hatch-main:hover { background: var(--color-coral-light, #ff9577); } .ds-hatch-ghost { background: var(--color-abyss, #04182b); color: var(--color-sand, #fff4e0); border: 2px solid var(--color-line, #1d5580); border-bottom-width: 5px; } .ds-hatch-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--color-glow, #5ef2e6); } .ds-hatch:active { translate: 0 3px; border-bottom-width: 2px; } .ds-hatch:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-glow, #5ef2e6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Pick one answer; aria-pressed fills it coral.
components.css: .ds-chip-row { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-chip { border-radius: 0.5rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-line, #1d5580); background: transparent; color: var(--color-sand, #fff4e0); padding: 0.25rem 0.75rem; font: 600 1.25rem/1.4 var(--font-sans, ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", "Nunito", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--color-glow, #5ef2e6); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed=true] { background: var(--color-coral, #ff7a59); border-color: var(--color-coral, #ff7a59); color: var(--color-abyss, #04182b); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-glow, #5ef2e6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat panel that holds each lab's game; the payoff variant adds an aqua border.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-panel, #0f3657); color: var(--color-sand, #fff4e0); border-radius: 1rem; padding: 1rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; font-family: var(--font-sans, ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", "Nunito", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-card p { margin: 0; } .ds-card-label { color: var(--color-glow, #5ef2e6); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-card-prompt { font-size: 1.875rem; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-card-ok { color: var(--color-kelp, #7ddc8a); font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Labeled field on an abyss well; focus is the global aqua ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; color: var(--color-sand, #fff4e0); font: 700 1.25rem/1.4 var(--font-sans, ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", "Nunito", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-input { max-width: 24rem; background: var(--color-abyss, #04182b); color: var(--color-sand, #fff4e0); border: 2px solid var(--color-line, #1d5580); border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font: 400 1.25rem/1.4 var(--font-sans, ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", "Nunito", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-glow, #5ef2e6); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Map Row
components.description: Map mode's navigation: one full-width card button per lab with a coral number badge and a worded status.
components.css: .ds-map-row { display: flex; width: 100%; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; text-align: left; background: var(--color-panel, #0f3657); color: var(--color-sand, #fff4e0); border: 2px solid var(--color-line, #1d5580); border-radius: 1rem; padding: 1rem; font-family: var(--font-sans, ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", "Nunito", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-map-row:hover { border-color: var(--color-glow, #5ef2e6); } .ds-map-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-glow, #5ef2e6); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-badge { display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 3rem; height: 3rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-coral, #ff7a59); color: var(--color-abyss, #04182b); font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 900; } .ds-map-text { flex: 1; } .ds-map-title { display: block; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-map-rule { display: block; opacity: 0.8; } .ds-map-done { color: var(--color-kelp, #7ddc8a); font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Pip's Bubble
components.description: Pip speaking: sand bubble, aqua border, a rotated-square tail aimed at Pip.
components.html: Hi, I'm Pip! Eight labs are waiting down there.
components.css: .ds-bubble-wrap { padding: 1rem 1rem 1.5rem; background: var(--color-deep, #0a2a45); } .ds-bubble { position: relative; margin: 0; max-width: 16rem; border: 3px solid var(--color-glow, #5ef2e6); border-radius: 1.25rem; background: var(--color-sand, #fff4e0); color: var(--color-abyss, #04182b); padding: 0.7rem 1rem; font: 700 1.125rem/1.4 var(--font-sans, ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", "Nunito", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6); } .ds-bubble-tail { position: absolute; bottom: -11px; left: 38%; width: 1rem; height: 1rem; rotate: 45deg; background: var(--color-sand, #fff4e0); border-right: 3px solid var(--color-glow, #5ef2e6); border-bottom: 3px solid var(--color-glow, #5ef2e6); }

components.name: Safety Plaque
components.description: The riveted plaque a teacher reads: safety line in aqua, teacher line in sand.
components.html:
No accounts. No chatting with a live AI. Nothing you type leaves this page. Map mode works offline once it loads.

For teachers: about 20 minutes, ages 10 to 14, no sign-up.
components.css: .ds-plaque { position: relative; max-width: 36rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #1d5580); border-radius: 1rem; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgb(15 54 87 / 0.95), rgb(10 42 69 / 0.95)); box-shadow: 0 16px 34px -18px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.8), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06); padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; font-family: var(--font-sans, ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", "Nunito", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-plaque p { margin: 0; } .ds-rivet { position: absolute; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #cfe0ea, #5d7483); } .ds-plaque-safe { color: var(--color-glow, #5ef2e6); font-weight: 700; } .ds-plaque-note { margin-top: 0.25rem !important; color: var(--color-sand, #fff4e0); opacity: 0.8; }

components.name: Porthole
components.description: The signature frame: brass conic rim, 12 bolts, vignetted glass onto the sea.
components.css: .ds-porthole { position: relative; width: 14rem; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 7%; background: conic-gradient(from 210deg, #f6d98b, #b8862f 16%, var(--color-brass, #e8b04a) 30%, #fff0c2 42%, #a8781f 58%, var(--color-brass, #e8b04a) 76%, #f6d98b); box-shadow: 0 34px 60px -24px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.75), inset 0 0 0 3px #8a6420, inset 0 -6px 14px rgb(90 58 10 / 0.5); } .ds-porthole-glass { position: relative; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #6b4a14; background: linear-gradient(var(--color-sea-top, #2b8fbc), var(--color-sea-mid, #0d527a) 55%, #062a45); } .ds-porthole-glass::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; background: radial-gradient(60% 40% at 30% 18%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.22), transparent 70%); box-shadow: inset 0 10px 40px 8px rgb(2 12 24 / 0.65); } .ds-porthole-bolt { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; } .ds-porthole-bolt::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 1.6%; width: 3.6%; aspect-ratio: 1; translate: -50% 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #fff3cc, #c89637 45%, #6b4a14); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5); }

narrative.overview:
Every screen is the inside of a small research sub parked at the bottom of the sea. The walls are deep navy hull plates, riveted along one seam every 150px. The thing you look at is a brass-rimmed porthole with twelve bolts, and through the glass is the lit station you are about to walk into. The palette, the heavy type and Pip (the small aqua robot guide) are the same on the start screen, the loading screen, Map mode, the lab overlays and the canvas-painted signs inside the 3D station, so a kid never feels they left the game to read a menu.

The world is dark, warm-lit and chunky. Text is warm sand on navy, never white on black. Controls are coral and feel like physical hatches: a heavy bottom edge that sinks 3px when pressed. Aqua belongs to Pip and to whatever Pip is pointing at, including the keyboard focus ring. Depth comes from three stacked navy tones, and real shadows are saved for the objects that are bolted into the sub (the porthole, the plaque, Pip's speech bubble, the hatch buttons). All scene art is inline SVG and CSS gradients; nothing is downloaded, because Chromebooks on school Wi-Fi are the home audience and Map mode must stay tiny.

The water keeps moving while a kid decides: kelp sways, bubbles rise, a small fish school swims past, the station beacon blinks, Pip bobs and waves. On the loading screen the porthole "sinks": bubbles rush up and the station rises 110px into view over 6s. Every one of these stops under `prefers-reduced-motion`. The world must never read as babyish (made for 6 year olds) or as a corporate AI startup landing page.
keyCharacteristics: Riveted navy hull (abyss, deep, panel) as the ground of every full-screen surface.
Brass porthole with 12 bolts as the signature frame; a 2.75rem mini porthole as the in-lab loader.
Coral for anything you press; aqua for Pip, focus and the payoff; kelp for right, urchin for wrong.
Heavy type (900 headings, 700 controls) in the game's own font stack, rounded where the device has a rounded system face.
Pressable things have a thick bottom edge (5px hatches, 4px keycaps).
Inline SVG and CSS only; no image or font downloads.

rules.name: The Coral Is the Kid's Hand Rule
rules.body: In interface chrome, coral marks what a kid presses, what the kid picked (their guess in the odds bars, the slider's value), the one rule a lab teaches, and their score on the license. Never use it for decoration or section headings. (Scene art may use it: the beacon, a rock, Pip's antenna.)

rules.name: The Aqua Is Pip's Rule
rules.body: Aqua marks Pip and the station's signposting: Pip's body and bubble, the focus ring, small labels, Map mode headings, the safety line, the payoff card's border. It never fills a button; coral owns pressing.

rules.name: The Never-Color-Alone Rule
rules.body: Kelp and urchin always travel with words ("Done", "Not yet", "Think again"). A result that is only green or only pink is not finished.

rules.name: The Token Rainbow Rule
rules.body: Token chunks cycle coral, glow, sun, kelp, urchin in that fixed order with abyss text, in the Token Reef lab and on the canvas signs in the 3D station alike. Keep the order; kids learn to read it.

rules.name: The Heavy Voice Rule
rules.body: Headings are always 900 and anything pressable is 700. Nothing in the interface is set lighter than 400.

rules.name: The One Stack Rule
rules.body: DOM text and canvas signs share one font stack. Never add a second display face or download a font to fix how the fallback looks; fix the layout instead.

rules.name: The Only-Objects-Cast Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this is bolted into the sub." Porthole, plaque, bubble and hatches cast; interface cards stay flat and separate by tone.

rules.name: The Hull Plate Rule
rules.body: The hull is plates, not graph paper: one horizontal seam every 150px (2px dark line, 1px highlight) with a rivet row just below it (26px apart, sand at 16%), over a radial pool of panel light behind the porthole. One axis only. The detector flags it as a line field; it stays because it is the sub's material.

dos: **Do** set every full-screen surface on the riveted hull, or on abyss with sand text, and every lab on panel cards inside the deep dialog.
**Do** draw new scene art as inline SVG or CSS gradients in the palette above; the start, loading and Map screens download no images and no fonts.
**Do** give anything pressable a coral fill or a 2px seam-line ghost border, and on physical hatches a 5px bottom edge that drops 3px when pressed.
**Do** show focus with the 3px aqua ring offset 3px, and keep Map mode a coral primary on touch and no-WebGL devices.
**Do** pair every kelp or urchin result with words.
**Do** let the water move (sway, rise, swim, bob, blink) and let `prefers-reduced-motion` stop all of it; every scene must read correctly frozen.
**Do** cycle token colors coral, glow, sun, kelp, urchin in that order, in the DOM and on canvas.
donts: **Don't** add a second axis to the hull seams or turn them into a grid.
**Don't** put shadows on interface cards, chips or the dialog; shadows are for the porthole, plaque, bubble and hatches.
**Don't** use coral for interface decoration or section headings, and don't fill a button with aqua.
**Don't** draw Pip in any color but aqua with an abyss visor.
**Don't** download a web font or swap the stack; the user pinned the game's look.
**Don't** let a surface read as babyish (made for 6 year olds) or as a corporate AI startup landing page.
